title: Realized purity maps and entire-tower projection coordinates
statement:
For a prime $\ell$, finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, schemes $X,Y$ and a compactification $X\xrightarrow j Z\xrightarrow p Y$ [def-pur-conventions, def-weil-compactifications-refinements], fix an integer $d\ge0$, a shifted Tate-line presentation $w$, the coefficient-tower calculus, normalized reduction equivalences $R_X,N_X,R_Y,N_Y$, the tower adjunction and its realization $r$ [det-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection, det-sp-tower-gamma]. Define $v_K$ by the reconstruction unit followed by total limit of the source comparison and tower gamma, inserting the section-equivalence unit and its inverse. Restrict compact support and the realized right adjoint to the full common finite-Tor categories [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], and restrict their adjunction by fully faithful inclusions. Define $\Gamma_K=v_K\delta_K$ using its unique counit-preserving right-adjoint comparison, and define its exceptional reduction by reduction of $\delta_K^{-1}$ followed by the actual reconstruction counit. Define the shifted integral Tate line $T$, twist reassociation $\sigma$, source-unit identification, completed right unitor and inverse fixed-compactification projection using the specified completed operations and actual completion units [def-pur-integral-derived-operations, def-pur-completed-projection-coordinates, def-pur-compactification-reduction-models, def-pur-completed-unit-pullback-data]. For the finite normalization definitions also fix the finite-field datum $D$, coefficient datum $C$, the embedding $E\subset C.\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, and a coefficient-stage exceptional RingSystem $S$ [def-pur-conventions, def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Define the finite left realization and the finite exceptional comparison normalized by its full site-comparison Hom chain; FiniteNormalization packages that natural isomorphism and its Hom equation, and finiteReduction composes it with the specified scalar mate. SourceNormalized is equality on every K-flat source representative to the total-single tensor collapse and the fixed tensor model. These eighteen existing declarations are relocated verbatim, with no changed data or signatures.

For $D=Lf^*K(d)[2d]$, let $b_D:r_Y PD\simeq F_\bullet r_XD$ be the pinned reconstruction comparison, $q_K:r_XD\simeq f_\bullet^*r_YK\otimes T_\bullet$ the source comparison and $a_\bullet$ the diagonal orientation. Define towerProjection to be $b_D$ followed by the fixed support realization, $F_\bullet(q_K(1\otimes a_\bullet))$, and the actual tower projection/counit word. It contains no integral realized purity map. For an integral arrow $z:PD\to K$, define reduceWord$(z)$ by restricting $z$ to the full constructible category, simultaneously reducing it and applying the section-preserving equivalence. Both are explicit composites; no object or morphism is chosen from a mere existence result.
